integrity.claim_scope: All commutative associative bilinear products on the fixed three-dimensional Lie algebra of upper triangular 2-by-2 matrices satisfying the integral transposed Leibniz identity, including the zero multiplication.
integrity.originality_scope: Finite-field counts, dimensions, and the characteristic-two trace-zero quotient/extension mechanism; no new complex-field isomorphism classification is asserted.
integrity.verification: A standalone standard-library checker accompanies a proof using exact parametric equations and fiber enumeration.

scientific_limitations: Labeled fixed-bracket multiplications, not isomorphism classes or orbit counts.
Characteristic two uses the literal polynomial transposed Leibniz identity, not half-derivations requiring the inverse of two.
The characteristic-two irreducible component decomposition, beyond dimension and open/boundary structure, is not determined.
Finite-field computations corroborate the symbolic argument; no computational exhaustion over all field sizes is claimed.
Potential equivalent modular enumerations under alternative terminology remain an originality risk.
title: A characteristic-two point-count jump for transposed-Leibniz products on triangular matrices
